pages.text: $(bold)Focus$() (default tool trait of Mithril, $(bold)leveled$())$(br2)While holding this tool your $(bold)casting cannot be interrupted$(), and each level grants $(bold)+5% cast speed$() (via the Cast Time Reduction attribute).$(br2)$(bold)How the interruption is blocked$(): Iron's Spells interrupts long casts unless the caster wears the Concentration Amulet - this trait simply intercepts that check while a Focus tool is held.$(br2)It stops the moment you put the tool away (the attribute is re-applied every 10 ticks).
